text:
anya: quick heads-up — ran a quant sweep for the 16B reranker (fp16 -> int8, int6) against devA/devB rerank sets. short summary below, full artifacts attached.

cale: can you post the numbers?

anya: tl;dr: int8 looks promising, int6 gives bigger cost wins but noticeable quality tail regressions. concrete: int8 ~ -44% cost, NDCG@10 delta -0.6pp, latency P95 +8ms. int6 ~ -61% cost, NDCG@10 delta -1.8pp, latency P95 +6ms.

eval-bot: automated report (summary):
```
model  | cost_rel | ndcg10_delta | p95_latency_ms | severe_regressions/200
fp16   | 1.00     | 0.00         | 120            | 0
int8   | 0.56     | -0.006       | 128            | 6
int6   | 0.39     | -0.018       | 126            | 14
```

shakir: looked through the 20 worst regressions for int6 — common pattern: reordering of long-tail entities (dates, rare tokens). some hallucinated highlights changed ordering. not just scoring shift, actual relevance loss in ~7 cases.

jen: from product/GTN perspective: 0.6pp NDCG drop is borderline but might be acceptable if CTR/engagement unchanged. need to confirm with online metrics. SLA-sensitive flows (in-app search) can't have regressions. can we route selectively?

anya: suggested rollout plan:
1) int8 canary at 15% for 48h, monitor NDCG@10, CTR, and top-query delta buckets. auto-rollback if NDCG drops >0.5pp OR CTR drops >3%.
2) enable prefix caching and candidate-level fallback for top 5k queries to mitigate tail regressions.
3) keep int6 in offline-only until we try mixed-precision fine-tune / calibration and re-evaluate.

cale: quick unit cost calc we used for planning:
```
assumptions: avg tokens/request = 80
fp16 per 1k tokens = $0.72 -> cost/request = $0.0576
int8 per 1k tokens  = $0.40 -> cost/request = $0.0320
int6 per 1k tokens  = $0.28 -> cost/request = $0.0224
per 1M requests: fp16 = $57.6k, int8 = $32k, int6 = $22.4k
savings vs fp16: int8 ~ $25.6k / 1M reqs, int6 ~ $35.2k / 1M reqs
```

shakir: operational note: int8 kvcache behavior differs slightly; we saw a ~2% miss-rate increase for long sequences which affects tail latency. test harness attached.

anya: next steps I've started:
- open PR with canary config + metric hooks (NDCG/CTR/top-template deltas)
- upload pickled 200 case failure set and 20 highlighted examples to drive manual triage
- add per-query routing table stub for fp16 fallback on flagged templates

jen: please add a one-paragraph GTN blurb for the sales doc: explain int8: good win for bulk traffic, suggest hybrid routing for SLA flows. keep it simple.

cale: recommendation summary for eng/product:
- Roll int8 for bulk traffic with conservative canary + automated rollback rules.
- Do not roll int6 to production yet; pursue quality recovery (calibration / small finetune / distill) and re-run sweep.
- Instrument per-query deltas and enable auto-fallback for top regressors.

shakir: i'll own the regression triage runbook and the list of templates to auto-fallback.

eval-bot: canary job created: https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/16b-rerank-int8-2240123456 (status: queued)

anya: I'll put the artifacts + short scoreboard in the eng-ml drive and link in the PR. tagging @jen for GTN notes.

jen: thanks all — this feels actionable. assign to me for the GTN blurb and to shakir for triage. :+1:
